categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Modifies `test/functional/wallet_fast_rescan.py` to harden wallet descriptor top-up and rescan verification.
categories.rationale: Improves test coverage and verification for wallet fast rescan to prevent silent regression bypasses. The author notes that previously 'the test code to cause the topups not being done that defeats the purpose of the test', and this PR adds explicit assertions on descriptor ranges and exact transaction IDs.
